acceptance_criteria: From the repository root /src/swe-af, the dependency-free command `python3 -m compileall -q swe_af/` exits with status code 0.
The command `python3 -m compileall -q swe_af/ ; echo EXIT:$?` prints `EXIT:0` as its final output line.
The command `python3 -m compileall -q swe_af/ 2>&1 | grep -ci 'error'` outputs exactly `0` (no compilation errors emitted for any module under swe_af/).
